rows.text: the **Additional Commissioner (Mumbai Central) dismisses its GST appeal, upholding a demand of Rs 3,75,29,796** — tax of Rs 1,87,64,898 plus an equal penalty — for July 2017 to September 2019. The company will appeal further.
